technical.summary: Oversold conditions present but severely undermined by pervasive bearish structure, negative volume signals, and absence of bullish confirmation—high-risk bounce setup only.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 42 days—insufficient smart money alignment for actionable signal.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity is mixed and weak with no clear conviction signal; news sentiment unavailable limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (405.28) with imminent FOMC event (1 day) and flat yield curve creates severe macro headwinds; earnings in 42 days adds secondary risk layer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9, Stochastic, Williams %R) combined with fear-zone sentiment (10/100) and price near support (98.50) create a classic contrarian bounce setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, MACD negative, CMF negative, three black crows, Ichimoku below cloud), zero fundamental conviction, crisis-level VIX (405.28), imminent FOMC event, and 42-day earnings risk eliminate any actionable edge despite oversold technicals.
